declaration: T11 -- declared externalisation of a configuration path literal. Replaces a string literal in a keep-verdict module with a call to towards_eeg.config.resolve(key), where the shipped default towards_eeg/config/paths.json maps key to the literal's exact prior bytes. Per occurrence the transform log records file, pre-edit line number, the exact prior line bytes (base64), the exact replacement line bytes (base64) and the key introduced; per file it records sha256 before and after and any inserted import line. The transform is INVERTIBLE FROM ITS OWN LOG: applying the recorded inverse to the current bytes must reproduce sha256_before exactly. That inversion, not a value comparison, is the behaviour-preservation proof required by TEEG_10 section 3.3.

Measured on e6e51ea, 21 July 2026: 6 quoted '/content' lines inside towards_eeg/, 113 in retain-verdict files outside it, 1 in tools/ (a comment, not a literal).
